name: BMW R1100RT / R1150RT
engine: 1085 or 1130 cc air/oil-cooled boxer twin, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: The oilhead RT tourers. Fuel injected boxer, shaft drive, and on R1150RTs a servo ABS that needs care.

H: Boxer twins need the valve clearance checked on both sides and the throttle bodies synced. Do both at the same service.
K: Servo-assisted ABS on the R1150RT needs a special bleed procedure. Read the manual before touching the brakes.

recallNote: BMW has issued several recalls across these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
